global.title: The emerging space economy brings opportunity and legal risks for business
global.summary: Private companies now design, launch, own and operate space assets on a scale and pace that was unthinkable a decade ago. items.title: The missing piece of America's supersonic comeback could also enable inland spaceports
items.summary: Two recent FAA actions could reshape how the United States approaches high-speed aviation and spaceflight. In July, the FAA announced a rulemaking effort to allow supersonic overland flight, implementing Executive Order 14304. Then, in August, the FAA issued a request for information toward implementing Executive Order 14369, which calls for the development of new U.S. spaceports, including “priority airspace” for launch and reentry operations.

items.title: EarthDaily joins Canada's satellite-imagery standing offer
items.summary: EarthDaily Analytics said Wednesday it has been added to the list of companies the Government of Canada can buy satellite imagery from without running a fresh competition each time. The National Master Standing Offer, or NMSO, is the mechanism the federal government uses that allows departments to acquire a service without having to create a procurement for each request.
